error.message:
probes: failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））
Re-checked after review 2026-10-14 (18:00 JST runs: fix-*.json). Legs error / empty / no-name / slow (35 s), both contexts: the right message shows ('The photo couldn't be read…' / 'No patients found in the image. Try a clearer photo.' / 'No residents found. Try a clearer photo.'), loading ends, nothing added. Slow leg, both contexts: loading visible at 3 / 15 / 30 s, message at ~35 s (Hospital re-run 18:00 JST, kept in evidence/history; NH from the 17:1x run). Retrying with the SAME photo starts no new read in every leg and context, on Chromium 151 (the file input still holds the file after a read, so no change event fires; the old message stays). With a byte-identical copy the retry adds its one row exactly once. NH double tap: Pecan 1, Rue 1, Quassia 0.
产品问题: After a failed or empty photo read, choosing the same image again ('Retake photo' in Hospital / 'Take Photo or Choose Image' in Nursing Home) starts no read and the old message stays, so the physician has to find or take a different photo. Shown on Chromium (desktop / Android WebView): the hidden file input is not cleared after a read (useCensusScan.ts handleImage / useResidentListScan never reset input.value), so the browser fires no change event for the same file. Breaks TC-02 S26 'lets the physician retry without retaking the photo' (oracle: a retry that needs the photo retaken is a Fail).

descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B32 · P2 · 新

照片读失败后，选同一张照片重试不会重新读，旧错误一直挂着（文件输入框没清空）

票：TFA-92580 rejected by qa；TFA-94425 ready for qa · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地

思路 / Approach · TC-02 Patient List Capture · S26 「读照片失败、慢或什么都没返回：清楚的提示，什么都不加，重试能用（两个模式）；养老院取消勾选和连点两次」 Photo read fails, is slow or returns nothing: clear message, nothing added, retry works (both contexts); Nursing Home deselect and double tap

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U12 When the photo read fails, times out, returns nothing or returns unusable output, the scan sheet stops loading, shows a clear message, adds no patient and lets the physician retry without losing the …（UAT 3.5；UAT OAT-03 step 7） — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U1 A screenshot or photo of a patient list, sent for capture, adds the patients to the list automatically via OCR, with no manual re-typing.（UAT TC-02；TFA-92580 AC 2；TFA-92580 How it works 2-3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U9 Runs and passes in both contexts: the Hospital capture (camera icon) and the Nursing Home 'Scan Resident List' (3.3).（UAT 3.3；TFA-92580 How it works 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Local stack, a fresh physician with the two fixture patients. scan-probe mocks ai/vision:scanCensusSheet at the Convex socket with e2e/support/action-observer.ts

When In each context, upload a fixture image while the mock answers with: (a) an error (success: false); (b) an empty list (Hospital { patients: [] }, Nursing Home { residents: [] }); (c) rows with no name (Hospital { patients: [{ room: '401' }] }, Nursing Home { residents: [{ unit: 'Cedar 10' }] }); …

Then Each failure ends the loading state with a clear message ('The photo couldn’t be read…' for a and d; 'No patients found in the image. Try a clearer photo.' or 'No residents found. Try a clearer photo.' for b and c), adds no patient, and lets the physician retry without retaking the photo. …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：scan-probe: the message is visible (the texts above, or any message that names the failure and the next step, until Q14) and the loading indicator is gone. A backend read shows 0 patients added per failure and exactly 1 per retry. For (d) the wait in ms is recorded for Q9. Nursing Home double tap: snf:list holds QA Pecan and QA Rue once each and QA Quassia 0 times. …

在哪跑：本地 probes（多端探针）；测试方法 FAULT · 故障注入；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S26 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-02.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：0 条。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane probes。

测试方法：FAULT · 故障注入（FAULT (scanCensusSheet mocked through page.routeWebSocket: error, empty, no-name rows, 35 s hold)）；辅助：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：probes。

UAT item: TC-02 Patient List Capture · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-02/S26

Tickets: TFA-92580 Patient List Capture (Scan Census OCR + manual add) (rejected by qa)

本地新 lane probes：probes/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（probes/plan.json，automatable: yes）：scan-probe per leg (error, empty, no-name, slow 35 s) and context: socket answer of scanCensusSheet scripted; message text, loading gone (slow: loading sampled at 3/15/30 s), 0 added; retry with the SAME photo (records whether a new read starts) then the one valid row is added exactly once; NH double tap with one unticked row. [Review 2026-10-14] Hospital slow leg re-run; per-leg evidence also kept under evidence/history so a later attempt cannot overwrite it; browser recorded (the same-file result is Chromium's). — All legs are client-observable with socket mocks.

Detail:

Re-checked after review 2026-10-14 (18:00 JST runs: fix-*.json). Legs error / empty / no-name / slow (35 s), both contexts: the right message shows ('The photo couldn't be read…' / 'No patients found in the image. Try a clearer photo.' / 'No residents found. Try a clearer photo.'), loading ends, nothing added. Slow leg, both contexts: loading visible at 3 / 15 / 30 s, message at ~35 s (Hospital re-run 18:00 JST, kept in evidence/history; NH from the 17:1x run). Retrying with the SAME photo starts no new read in every leg and context, on Chromium 151 (the file input still holds the file after a read, so no change event fires; the old message stays). With a byte-identical copy the retry adds its one row exactly once. NH double tap: Pecan 1, Rue 1, Quassia 0.

产品问题：After a failed or empty photo read, choosing the same image again ('Retake photo' in Hospital / 'Take Photo or Choose Image' in Nursing Home) starts no read and the old message stays, so the physician has to find or take a different photo. Shown on Chromium (desktop / Android WebView): the hidden file input is not cleared after a read (useCensusScan.ts handleImage / useResidentListScan never reset input.value), so the browser fires no change event for the same file. Breaks TC-02 S26 'lets the physician retry without retaking the photo' (oracle: a retry that needs the photo retaken is a Fail).

证据：附了 10 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — scan-probe runs only on the local stack (runNotes): a fresh physician, seeding through e2e/support/backend.ts (admin key) and failures injected by mocking ai/vision:scanCensusSheet with action-observer.ts.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
